story.heading: A first dentist they will come back to
paragraphs: Kids remember how a visit felt. We keep the room calm, the words simple, and the work careful.
Parents get a plain explanation before anything starts. No surprises, no rush.
Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry serves people who live and work in Delaware County.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.

experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: Small mouths, careful work
feature.text: Sealants, cleanings, and repairs are paced for children. We would rather go slow than scare someone out of coming back.

spotlight.heading: Wilmington West Chester Pike
spotlight.text: The Glen Mills office is set up for families. Call ahead if your child is nervous. We will make time.
